npcs.name: Pepe Bleau
lines:
Ah, a new face!
Welcome to Les Sables d'Or.

See the yellow numbers on the blocks?
That's the yellow circuit.

Start with number 1, La Premiere.
It's right by your tent.

Read the rock: where there's chalk,
others found something to hold.

npcs.name: Sanne
lines:
I've lost my crash pad!
I had it a minute ago.

It must be somewhere between the blocks.
Tell me if you see it.

npcs.name: Mat
lines:
Behind those trees stands Le Grand Saut,
4c, a proper highball.

It's not in any circuit.
Bring two pads, though!

npcs.name: Tim
lines:
Psst, behind La Dalle aux Fourmis
there's a hidden block.

La Cachette, a 4a. It's in no guide,
only in your own topo.

npcs.name: Ranger
lines:
Here starts the path to
the next sector, Cul de Chien.

I only let seasoned climbers through.
Climb the yellow circuit first!

npcs.name: Yara
lines:
Le Pot de Chalk has a big pocket
halfway up. You can rest there.

Look where your feet can go first,
then your hands.

Le Saut, at the back: that hold you only
reach with a jump. Sink low, and grab
at the moment you hang still.

gate.text: The path to Cul de Chien is still closed.
